title: Generic finite splitting over a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite morphism with $Y$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let $V\subseteq Y$ be a dense open. There is a dense open $U\subseteq V$ and an etale covering family $(T_i\to U)_i$ such that for every $i$ the fibre product $P_i=T_i\times_U f^{-1}(U)$ [def-pc-fibre-product] has a finite pairwise disjoint open covering $(W_{ij})_{j\in\operatorname{Fin}(n_i)}$, and every composite $W_{ij}\to P_i\to T_i$ is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. The cover and partition are independent of any sheaf. The integer $n_i$ may be zero.

proof.text: Reduce Y. Its irreducible components form a finite family. Remove their pairwise intersections; each remaining component is open and integral. In each choose a nonempty affine open inside V. Apply exists_dense_open_finite_scheme_splitting to the finite map over this integral Noetherian affine open, and shrink to its dense splitting open. Each resulting open contains the generic point of its component, so their union is dense and lies in V.

The reduction immersion is a nilpotent thickening because Y is Noetherian. Etale-site equivalence lifts each etale covering scheme from the reduced open to the corresponding open of Y. Lift its structural map, and use invariance of the underlying space to see that these lifted etale maps jointly cover U. Open component inclusions compose with the lifted covers to make an etale cover of U.

The reduction of the finite source over each lifted cover is the finite disjoint union from the affine splitting. Lift its clopen partition along the reduction homeomorphism. Each lifted piece remains finite over the cover: a clopen subscheme of a finite scheme is finite. It is universally injective and surjective because these properties are unchanged by nilpotent reduction of source and target, also after any base change. Hence it is a universal homeomorphism. Empty inverse images give empty partitions; for empty Y use U empty and the empty covering family.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dense_open_finite_noetherian_scheme_splitting
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (V : Y.Opens) (hV : Dense (V : Set Y)) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, U ≤ V ∧ Dense (U : Set Y) ∧
      ∃ 𝒯 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage U.toScheme, ∀ i,
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → (pullback (𝒯.f i) (f ∣_ U)).Opens),
          (⨆ j, W j) = ⊤ ∧ Pairwise (fun j k ↦ Disjoint (W j) (W k)) ∧
          ∀ j, IsUniversalHomeomorphism
            ((W j).ι ≫ pullback.fst (𝒯.f i) (f ∣_ U))
